Vendor binaries

These files come from the device makers' stock firmware or SDKs. They are
proprietary to their makers and are included so spruce can run on the
hardware they were written for.

Miyoo (https://lomiyoo.com/)
  miyoo/lib/libgamename.so, librsautil.so, libshmvar.so, libtmenu.so
  spruce/miyoomini/bin/audioserver, keymon, adbd
  miyoo/lib/libpadsp.so (via OnionUI)
  Emu/PSP/miyoo282_xpad_inputd
  spruce/FIRMWARE_UPDATE/miyoo282_fw.img.7z (Miyoo A30 stock firmware)
  spruce/flip/miyoo355_rootfs_32.img_part* (Miyoo Flip 32-bit root filesystem)

TrimUI (https://trimui.net/)
  spruce/smartpro/inputd/trimui_inputd, spruce/brickpro/inputd/trimui_inputd,
  spruce/smartpros/inputd/trimui_inputd

Anbernic / Allwinner / ARM
  spruce/h700/lib32/libmali.so.0 and its libEGL, libGLESv1_CM, libGLESv2
  (ARM Mali driver from the Anbernic stock image)

ARM / Rockchip
  spruce/flip/libmali-bifrost-g52-g2p0-gbm.so (see Mali-EULA.txt)

muOS (https://muos.dev/)
  spruce/flip/muOS-pixie-reduced.sqsh-part* is a reduced muOS 2410 root
  filesystem. Its contents are under their own licenses.
